nodes.title: Owner priorities (2026-10-04), outranked only by the child-safety floor: (1) covert comprehension truth + re-teach differently; (2) teacher-child relationship over time with consistent personality and behaviour; (3) on-the-go content generated for this child from their learning choices, behaviour, patterns and techniques; (4) superb product design: every built artifact appears inside its stage area, fitted, interactive, never overflowing, and the full student flow is designed end to end; (5) classes 4-7 launch focus; model optimisation later. Reverse only on the owner's word.

Live whiteboard: explanations are drawn step by step in sync with the teacher's speech from a model-written drawing script (strokes, shapes, labels, arrows, number work with timings) rendered by our own code inside the StudioStage; computer-use agents are rejected for live drawing (seconds per action, unreliable, no sync with speech). Reverse if a computer-use model renders a correct, speech-synced drawing under 1 s per step.
